name: Opportunity Radar
description: Keep versioned sources, reviewed growth opportunities and drafts, with bounded AI source briefing. Automated discovery, outreach and publication are not yet available.

navLinks.label: Opportunity Radar
navLinks.description: Sourced business opportunities, research and reviewed actions.

settings.label: Organization
settings.description: Your public business or project name.

settings.label: Website
settings.description: Your public HTTPS website. This setting does not authorize fetching URLs.

settings.label: Spokesperson
settings.description: Optional public representative; leave blank for organization-only work.

settings.label: Mission and offer
settings.description: What you do and the useful contribution you can make.

settings.label: Earned expertise
settings.description: Firsthand experience you can substantiate; do not enter unsupported credentials.

settings.label: Business audiences
settings.description: The customers, professional communities or institutions you serve.

settings.label: Topics
settings.description: Business topics to watch. Public affairs requires separate neutral review, not growth scoring.

settings.label: Public assets
settings.description: Public URLs/descriptions, one per line. These are owned resources, not independent coverage.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: Geographic focus, or leave blank for no regional restriction.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Chicago. Scheduling is not active in this foundation.

settings.label: Daily shortlist limit
settings.description: Maximum reviewed business recommendations returned by daily selection.

settings.label: Daily discovery limit
settings.description: Future worker cap; this does not start discovery.

settings.label: Daily model budget (USD)
settings.description: Zero disables automatic model spending. Model jobs must reserve the budget before calls.

settings.label: Model spending mode
settings.description: Applies to source briefing jobs. Off makes no model calls; free-only must never fall back to paid models.

settings.label: Preferred registered model
settings.description: Explicit model ID from the shared evaluated model registry. OpenRouter is the current transport; no premium default or invented model IDs.

settings.label: Daily model call limit
settings.description: Independent call cap, including free models and retries. Zero disables automatic model calls.

settings.label: Input token limit per call
settings.description: Bound retrieved evidence before a model request.

settings.label: Output token limit per call
settings.description: Short structured results; no unbounded drafting loops.

settings.label: Maximum cost per run (USD)
settings.description: Model jobs reserve worst-case cost before requests; zero allows no paid request.

settings.label: Source mode
settings.description: No paid-source activation. Available public sources still have usage limits.

settings.label: Outreach mode
settings.description: Draft-only never sends. Approval-required still needs a verified sender, current checks and exact human approval for every message.

settings.label: Daily outreach limit
settings.description: Maximum reserved Radar messages per UTC day; uncertain attempts consume the limit.

settings.label: Recipient cooldown (hours)
settings.description: Recent outbound messages to any recipient stop another Radar send. Uncertain acceptance must be reconciled first.

settings.label: Forbidden outreach phrases
settings.description: One literal phrase per line. Matching phrases block approval; no executable regular expressions.

settings.label: Allow existing approved financial terms
settings.description: Allow only terms stated verbatim in current approved facts. Every message still requires human review; this cannot create a new payment commitment.
